transcript.text: Hi, good evening! This is Shreya calling from Mumbai Bank. Am I speaking with Mr. Rahul?
Yes, this is Rahul speaking. How can I help you?
Thank you. I'm an automated assistant, and this call is recorded. Is your Mumbai Bank card the one ending in four, two, seven, one?
Yeah, that's the one, but I’m really struggling right now.
Got it, thanks. It looks like this month's payment hasn't come through yet. Is all well?
No, not really. I lost my job a few weeks ago, so I don’t have any money coming in.
I'm really sorry you're going through this. Please don't worry about this call right now. Would you like a callback from a human agent to help you through this?
I appreciate that, but I’m not sure a callback will help. I just don’t have any money to pay right now.
